objective: Upgrade the existing Kaggle notebook fabric with a ShortForge-owned Wan Dual-T4 renderer reference architecture.

rulesConsidered: Community notebooks are references, not authority or runtime dependencies.
Kaggle notebook execution remains separate from F06 worker authority.
Every successful render must end in a physical artifact subject to independent verification.
F07 remains the independent physical artifact truth boundary.
Provider capability claims must be supported by live evidence before qualification.

notes: Optional HF_TOKEN is read from Kaggle Secrets inside the notebook runner.
Renderer request metadata is allowlisted to prevent arbitrary environment/secret injection.
Live Wan model execution is manual-only and quota-aware.

changes: Added Kaggle renderer profiles for deterministic proof, Wan 1.3B, and explicit Wan 14B dual-T4.
Added repository-owned Kaggle kernel template with T4 inventory detection.
Added deterministic GPU-backed proof mode with no model download.
Added opt-in Wan 2.1 T2V mode using Diffusers and balanced placement on multi-GPU hosts.
Extended Kaggle adapter to package owned notebook templates.
Added manual Kaggle Wan renderer workflow and template validation.
evidenceRefs: Kaggle public Wan Dual-T4 Runner reference
Hugging Face Diffusers multi-GPU device_map=balanced documentation
verificationPlan: Pass repository CI and Team Change Gate.
Run the manual Kaggle Wan workflow in PROOF mode first.
Then run WAN_T2V_1_3B as an explicit model-backed smoke.
Only after 1.3B passes, optionally experiment with WAN_DUAL_T4_14B.
Do not record 14B as qualified until a physical Kaggle run succeeds.
Use the existing downstream CAS/F07 render path for provider qualification.
notes: This PR upgrades the renderer foundation; it does not claim live Wan feasibility.
The deterministic PROOF profile is intentionally the first live target to minimize GPU quota usage.
